whenToUse: You announce a newly added menu item or feature.
You draw attention lightly without explanation.
whenNotToUse: You'd put it on several menu items at once (people won't know where to look first).
A count is needed (use a badge).
A detailed explanation is needed (use a feature introduction or a coach mark).
accessibility: The dot is decorative, and visually hidden "new" text is read after the menu name.
It disappears once the menu is opened, and that fact is saved so it doesn't come back.
However small the dot, the whole menu item is the pressable area.
The current menu item is marked separately with aria-current.
